label: Young People Navigating the Looping Effects of Long Covid: Exhausting Agency and the 'Ongoing After' of Pandemic.
summary: Seeing beyond the COVID-19 pandemic as an extraordinary spectacle situated in the past, we draw on qualitative research with young people to trace experiences of Long Covid as 'looping effects' of entangling physical and social impacts which intersect with, and extend, those of pandemic. Navigating the capacity to do ordinary things becomes highly contingent, and exhausting work, in the face of Long Covid.
